game.title: Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection
game.blurb: Collection of two action-adventure games, Uncharted 4: A Thief's End and Uncharted: The Lost Legacy, from Naughty Dog and Iron Galaxy, released 2022-01-28. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours (well under a full run of both games). Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1659420)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Uncharted:_Legacy_of_Thieves_Collection
Fandom (uncharted.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://uncharted.fandom.com/wiki/Uncharted:_Legacy_of_Thieves_Collection
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 1, but it is a compilation page with no subpages of its own; the written guides live under the separate Uncharted 4 and The Lost Legacy pages, so no structure was taken from it. uncharted.fandom.com answers the API, but its page has only 2 links. The Steam schema calls the app "Olympic" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1659420. 35 of 101 Steam achievements are hidden. The Steam list mixes both games: everything from "Legacy Found!" onward was treated as The Lost Legacy by its schema position and named content, and hidden ones sit in each game's story chapter as a placeholder. Many hidden ones are probably optional moments rather than story beats.
